title: Rediseño de dashboards · Empresa y Métricas
brief: Company dashboard (/empresa/dashboard) and company metrics (/empresa/metricas) redesigned with order, air and a reading path, following the new Dashboards rules in design/system.md and the research in design/dashboard-redesign/research.md

artboards.title: 01 · Pulso · Dashboard
artboards.tradeoff: Bento close to the references: hero KPI, main chart, attention card; most familiar, needs deltas (N1) to shine

artboards.title: 02 · Pulso · Métricas
artboards.tradeoff: Same bento for metrics: strong first glance, detail pushed down; recruiter table trimmed to 6 columns

artboards.title: 03 · Historia · Dashboard
artboards.tradeoff: Sections titled as questions with lots of air; calm and guided, longer scroll

artboards.title: 04 · Historia · Métricas
artboards.tradeoff: Metrics told as a story (¿Cómo vamos? ¿Dónde se atora? ¿Quién?); easiest to read for a stakeholder, less dense

artboards.title: 05 · Foco · Dashboard
artboards.tradeoff: Minimal first screen plus an attention rail; fastest to act, hides analysis behind tabs

artboards.title: 06 · Foco · Métricas
artboards.tradeoff: Overview strip + tabs Resumen / Reclutadores / Clientes; one screen at a time, needs a click to compare

artboards.title: 07 · Métricas combinada (elegida por el usuario, L5)
artboards.tradeoff: KPIs de 02, curva de cierres al estilo 01, estado de entregas, pipeline, retrasos y desempeño de 03/04; cada cifra abre su detalle; origen al final

artboards.title: 08 · Detalle filtrado (indagar una cifra)
artboards.tradeoff: Página de detalle a la que lleva cualquier número: filtros como chips, estados, tabla ordenable, exportar

artboards.title: 09 · Dashboard de empresa
artboards.tradeoff: Día a día del reclutador con las reglas de 07: «Necesita atención» protagonista, pipeline por etapa, vacantes y candidatos, postulaciones al final
